title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts launching chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent fraud, following a successful Worcester-area pilot.
Nearly 1 million residents utilize SNAP benefits; new cards aim to combat theft, not recipient misuse, says Gov. Healey.
Retailers are updating payment systems for new cards; some may still require swiping if systems aren't upgraded.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall offers 'pet certificates' for couples marrying, recognizing pets as part of their union.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the program celebrating pets' commitment and inclusion in family ceremonies at City Hall.
Registrar Paul Chong issued the first 'pet certificate' to a couple and their golden retriever, Bono.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon shares insights on social media's impact on stand-up comedy and his evolving online presence.
Nealon discusses his New England roots and SNL career, including memorable sketches and collaborations with Dana Carvey.
Upcoming performances in Boston and Portsmouth coincide with promoting his special, 'Loose in the Crotch,' on YouTube.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox catcher Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers' Will Klein in the head.
Contreras stayed in the game initially but was removed for precautionary reasons after the next half-inning.
Tests on Contreras showed no immediate issues, but further evaluation is pending for possible concussion symptoms.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as an assistant wide receivers coach after participating in Patriots training camp.
Hopkins brings extensive experience and leadership, having played five Pro Bowls and previously coached under Mike Vrabel.
Georgia Tech announced Hopkins will work with offensive coordinator George Godsey, enhancing their ACC football strategies.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Patriots wide receivers Efton Chism and Kyle Williams excelled with touchdown grabs during a recent red zone drill.
The Patriots face a challenge with seven competing wide receivers for likely six available roster spots in 2026.
Wide receiver Kayshon Boutte's potential trade could impact roster decisions, affecting players like Chism and Williams.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer is open to a trade from the Blue Jays to the Red Sox, per CBS Sports reports.
The Red Sox are interested in acquiring Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards to strengthen their middle infield.
Springer has a strong performance history at Fenway Park, batting .323 with 10 home runs in 51 games.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is streaming on Hulu.
Zendaya and Robert Pattinson star in 'The Drama,' a dark comedy streaming on HBO Max.
'Furious' Season 1, a series about a rookie FBI agent, is streaming on Hulu.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran made headlines for his reaction to a base-running decision during the Red Sox's win over the Athletics.
Broadcasts from multiple networks criticized Duran for an on-field outburst directed toward teammate Willson Contreras and coach Chad Epperson.
The Red Sox are open to trading Duran before Monday's deadline, amid recent controversy over his public display of frustration.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown are building chemistry in Patriots training camp, with increased connections in recent practices.
Maye completed all but one pass during team drills, showing confidence in targeting Brown frequently for completions.
The Patriots focus on communication and understanding between Maye and Brown as they prepare for tight coverages this season.
